description.p: rumd renders Markdown with a centered reading column and refreshes automatically when the file changes on disk. The source pane is always editable, with the rendered view updating live as you type.

ul.li: GFM tables, task lists, strikethrough, and syntax-highlighted code blocks
Split view with editable source and live preview
Highlighted search across rendered and source views
Dark/light theme, zoom, and auto-reload on file changes
